findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: "В Іспанії cuál не ставлять безпосередньо перед іменником: ¿Qué libro?, а не «¿Cuál libro?»."
findings.description: The categorical geographical prohibition overstates the distinction. Adnominal interrogative cuál exists; its use is substantially more frequent in America than in Spain. A regional preference should not be presented as an exceptionless prohibition.
findings.suggestion: State that qué before a noun is the usual contemporary Peninsular pattern, while adnominal cuál is much more frequent in American Spanish.

items.reviewerAnswer: Cuál identifies a singular referent or information value; cuáles identifies plural referents. Qué before a noun is the usual contemporary Peninsular model.
items.notes: The supplied examples with qué and pronominal cuál/cuáles are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «cuál», interrogative adjectival use before a noun and geographical distribution (from memory).

findings.location: task.options[id=a].feedbackUk: "Qué es…? питає, що це таке взагалі. Конкретний номер — ¿Cuál es…?"
findings.description: The first Spanish question model has a closing question mark but lacks the required opening ¿.

items.notes: The answer key itself is correct.

RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española, treatment of opening and closing interrogation marks (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Обери питальне слово (перед іменником)."; task.options[id=b]: "Cuál", graded "incorrect".
findings.description: Qué is the clear default model for Spain, but adnominal cuál is not categorically excluded from Spanish usage in Spain. Whether option b is acceptable in the intended register is unconfirmed: the prompt does not explicitly request the usual neutral Peninsular form or specify a variant policy.
findings.suggestion: Specify that learners must select the usual neutral form in contemporary Spain, or resolve the treatment of marked adnominal cuál before grading it incorrect.

items.reviewerAnswer: a is the ordinary contemporary Peninsular answer; b may fit a marked adnominal use of cuál.
items.notes: Qué should remain the beginner model. The uncertainty concerns categorical rejection of the alternative.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «cuál», interrogative adjectival use and geographical distribution (from memory).
Review verdict definition: use uncertain when acceptability depends on an unspecified register or regional usage.
